title: SOS rate-limit dict unbounded by minted identities (TOFU)
description: Codereview edge-pass finding on b7z9.121.3: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py SosResource._request_times/_period_start grow per distinct from_hex with no global cap (_prune_old_requests prunes only the accessing source). TOFU accepts any new key so a radio adversary mints identities and grows both dicts without bound. OriginSequenceTracker (bounded 256 LRU) proves this was an oversight. Fix: bound like origin-tracker (to max_origins entries, LRU eviction).
close_reason: Fixed: rate-limit map now uses OrderedDict with LRU eviction bounded by MAX_RATE_LIMIT_SOURCES=256 (mirrors OriginSequenceTracker bound); test_rate_limit_entries_bounded added.
